Hi Ben — thanks for the report and the screenshot. We opened ticket PC-112233. Quick notes: 

- Claim mapping: Our invites include two fields used for tenant binding: "organization_id" and "tax_identifier". If the invite payload includes both and they differ, the portal rejects the registration. We can either: accept a corrected invite (organization_id == tax_identifier) or map an alternate identifier if you supply an explicit mapping table.

- OTP routing: The OTP address comes from the contact_email field in the vendor profile the invite creates. If Acme's SSO/IDP is returning an alias or legacy email in the token, the portal will honor that value. We recommend the vendor update their IDP to return their procurement email attribute.

Workarounds: We can (a) manually provision the vendor account if you email us an authorization from Redwood's procurement owner, or (b) provide a one-time invite with an override payload (we'll sign the request).

I'm attaching the invite creation logs we have for the invite you referenced (procureco-invite-log.txt). If you can share the raw invite ID or the vendor org claim values we can debug the mapping quickly.

Regards,
